prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Sony 3.1 Channel Home Theater Surround System In Black - HTCT100; brand: sony; description: Sony 3.1 Channel Home Theater Surround System In Black - HTCT100/ HDMI Active Intelligence/ LPCM Playback/ 3.1 Channel/ S-Force Surround/ BRAVIA® Sync/ Digital Media Port/ Black Finish/ ETA MID JANUARY 2009; price: $299.00

Candidates:
1. name: Sony HT7200DH Home Theater System; brand: Sony; description: DVD Player, A/V Receiver, 5.1 Speakers - 1 Disc(s) - Progressive Scan - 1000W RMS - Dolby Digital, Dolby Pro Logic, Dolby Pro Logic II, DTS; price: $376.96; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
2. name: Sony BRAVIA DAV-HDX279WC Home Theater System; brand: Sony; description: DVD Player, 6.1 Speakers - 5 Disc(s) - Progressive Scan - Dolby Digital, DTS, Dolby Pro Logic II - Black; price: $318.01; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
3. name: Sony HT-DDWG700 Home Theater System - HTDDWG700; brand: Sony; description: DVD Player, 5.1 Speakers - 900W RMS - DTS, Dolby Digital, Dolby Pro Logic II; price: $206.96; check: model numbers differ, brand equal

response.text: {"reason": "The price-list item has model number HTCT100 which does not match any candidate's model number.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.9}
